verdict.rationale: The pack has no documented retention settings or run/payload deletion features. The only relevant control is self-hosting (trigger-dev-docs-17), which puts the platform and its data stores on your own infrastructure, so you could manage retention and deletion yourself. That is an indirect workaround, not a product capability. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods on Cloud, API/SDK or dashboard deletion of runs, payloads, outputs and logs, documented data-deletion or retention policy, independent corroboration.
